ei.title: Job Opportunity Outlook by Income Level Amid AI Adoption

fullPassage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.

questions.passage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the (A)[impact / absence] of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting (B)[fewer / greater] job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more. More than one-third of lower-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about (C)[one-fourth / one-half] of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: AI 도입의 영향(impact), 더 적은(fewer) 일자리 기회, 상위 소득 근로자의 약 1/4(one-fourth).
det.analysis:
✅ ① impact — fewer — one-fourth: 원문 일치
❌ ② absence(부재)는 impact의 반의어
❌ ③ greater(더 많은)는 fewer의 반의어
❌ ④ one-half(1/2)은 one-fourth(1/4)과 다름

questions.passage: Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much (A)[difference / progress], which was more than (B)[twice / half] the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would (C)[create / eliminate] more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 큰 차이(difference)를 만들지 않을 것, 두 배(twice) 이상, 더 많은 일자리를 만들(create) 것.
det.analysis:
✅ ② difference — twice — create: 원문 일치
❌ ① progress(발전)는 difference와 다름
❌ ③ half(절반)는 twice의 반의어
❌ ④ eliminate(제거)는 create의 반의어
det.tip: make much difference(큰 차이를 만들다), twice(두 배)

questions.passage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI (A)[outnumbered / equaled] those expecting more, while nearly a third (B)[foresaw / ignored] little impact. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than (C)[three / two] times the share of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 기회 감소 예상자가 증가 예상자보다 수가 많았고(outnumbered), 거의 1/3이 영향이 적을 것으로 예상했고(foresaw), 세 배(three) 이상.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ outnumbered — foresaw — three: 원문 일치
❌ ① equaled(같았다)는 outnumbered의 반의어
❌ ② ignored(무시했다)는 foresaw(예상했다)의 반의어
❌ ④ two(두 배)는 three(세 배)와 다름
